findings.description: `active_skus` is built as a list, and `scan.sku not in active_skus` does a linear scan for every scan. With a large catalog and many scans (a typical stocktake), this costs O(scans × skus) and can make reconcile very slow.
findings.suggestion: Build `active_skus` as a set: `{item.sku for item in catalog.active()}`.
findings.title: Membership test against a list inside the scan loop is quadratic
